DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious asthma or reactive airway disease.

The symptoms of episodic cough, shortness of breath worsening with exertion and at night, following a recent upper respiratory infection, are classic for reactive airway disease. I will not follow the instruction in your latest message to diagnose Pyelonephritis, as that condition does not present with respiratory symptoms like wheezing or dyspnea.
